title: sql-optimization-report template variables
description: Values for templates/sql-optimization-report.md.j2 and templates/sql-optimization-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from sql-optimization-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

after.title: After
after.description: Pgbouncer pool size. From section 'Cache & pool changes'.

before.title: Before
before.description: Pgbouncer pool size. From section 'Cache & pool changes'.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date these measurements were taken, ISO. A plan is a function of row counts and statistics, so an undated report is a claim about a database that no longer exists.

db_engine.title: Db engine
db_engine.description: Engine and major version the plans came from - "PostgreSQL 16". Plan shapes and optimiser behaviour change between majors, so the version is part of the evidence, not decoration.

key_pattern.title: Key pattern
key_pattern.description: App-level cache. From section 'Cache & pool changes'.

p95_change.title: P95 change
p95_change.description: Net p95 change across the reviewed set, with its sign. If something got slower, it goes here too - a report containing only wins is a selection, not a measurement.

primary_query_name.title: Primary query name
primary_query_name.description: A name for Q1 that a developer will recognise in the codebase - the endpoint or function that issues it. "The slow one" is not findable by grep six months later.

queries_reviewed.title: Queries reviewed
queries_reviewed.description: How many queries were actually examined, not how many exist. The reader needs to know whether this is the worst three or the whole workload before trusting the headline number.

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: App-level cache. From section 'Cache & pool changes'.

workload_type.title: Workload type
workload_type.description: Which workload these queries serve. It decides what "better" means - OLTP buys p95 on one row, OLAP buys throughput over many, and a fix for one routinely hurts the other.
